The '''Celdaru system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay outside the borders of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The system shared its name with the epithet "Scourge of Celdaru," which was self-assumed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Sulamar]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Celdaru system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square I-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
